fields.acceptance: A new TestStartAgent in internal/api/run_checks_panes_test.go with paneRunner calls StartAgent for a plan step after a session with block:a1 and asserts one rex split of block:a1 and no window new; with an empty session store it asserts exactly one window new; no test runs real Rex
fields.statement: An agent step's session, such as a plan run's interview, review or revise, splits the pane of the run's latest session with a pane, and opens a window only when it is the run's first session with a pane

fields.acceptance: Go tests TestStartArbiterSplits and TestStartAdvisorSplits build their fixtures with a run session whose tab block is block:a1 and assert the fake rex gets split -b block:a1 and never window new; a testscript arbiter-panes-one-window.txtar runs an autonomous agent step whose fake claude asks two questions and its fake rex log matches one window new then only splits
fields.statement: An autonomous run's arbiter sessions and the advisor sessions opened on owner questions split a pane of the run's window, so a run with many questions opens no window for them

fields.acceptance: A Go test drives an arbiter to a journalled verdict and an advisor to a journalled recommendation with a fake rex and asserts a block close of each session's pane after the journal entry; a failed or still-running arbiter's pane is not closed
fields.statement: An arbiter session's pane is closed once its verdict is journalled, and an advisor session's once its recommendation is, so the run window keeps only live panes
